structure: Part 13 read every one of the 23 files in src/server/app/shared/ in full (2,828 lines): the page chrome (layout.njk, layout.test.js), the shared view-model kit (kit.js, kit.test.js), the save controls every collecting page ends with (save-actions.njk, save-actions.test.js), the caption macro (section-caption.njk, section-caption.test.js), the error page and error summary partials (error.njk, error-summary.njk), the Back-link trail (trail.js, trail.test.js), the set registry and its per-set seams (set-context.js, set-context.test.js), the URL shapes (paths.js), the paging helpers (paging.js), the macro loader (render-macro.js, render-macro.test.js) and the shared copy pair with its locale resolver and leaf convention (copy.js, copy.en.js, copy.cy.js, copy.test.js, copy-leaves.js). It covers the chrome shown on every page of the high-risk plants set (header, service navigation, Alpha phase banner, Back link, journey status strip, recoverable-error and stale-action banners, content column width, footer, page title), every control save-actions.njk offers a collecting page, the error-summary and error-page partials and their copy, every key of shared/copy.en.js and shared/copy.cy.js verbatim with the chrome each feeds, the URL shapes paths.js defines, the paging rules paging.js defines, and the Back-link trail and return marker. trail.js, set-context.js, render-macro.js, copy-leaves.js, readDate and inDashboardSection are claimed as mechanism. Two things the part's covers expected are not in the slice and are recorded as gaps: kit.js holds no Nunjucks macros (the shared macros live in save-actions.njk and section-caption.njk, and kit.js is a JavaScript view-model and route-option module), and paging.js defines no page size. The slice stops at the set's own pages, which parts 1 to 11 claim.
